sentences.text: Good morning. May I have your passport, please?
sentences.translation: 早上好。请出示您的护照。

sentences.text: Here you go. I'd like a window seat if possible.
sentences.translation: 给您。如果可以的话我想要靠窗的座位。

sentences.text: Certainly. Do you have any luggage to check in?
sentences.translation: 好的。有行李需要托运吗？

sentences.text: Please place it on the scale. Your flight will depart from gate 12.
sentences.translation: 请把它放在秤上。您的航班将在12号登机口起飞。

sentences.text: Here is your boarding pass. Have a pleasant flight!
sentences.translation: 这是您的登机牌。祝您旅途愉快！
